approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (Axe the Tampon Tax) Bill 2018
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would stop the goods and services tax from applying to menstrual products.
It would add a new GST-free category for items used during menstruation, including tampons, pads, cups and sponges among others.
The change would start the day after the bill receives royal assent.
Defines the products that would be exempt.
Sets the commencement date as the day after royal assent.
People who menstruate and purchase sanitary products.
